You will also be responsible for assessing and choosing the right solution for the task at hand whilst considering cost implications and other trade\-offs. Your vision and ideas will be incorporated with a close working relationship with product to build the industry's leading service.
   

  

 If you have a passion for leading productive engineering teams, working hands\-on developing distributed systems and are utilising AI, we'd love to hear from you!
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead and mentor a cross\-functional team of engineers, providing technical direction, coaching and support.
* Design, build, deploy and monitor scalable, high\-quality software systems supporting Ten's global member base.
* Work closely with Product, Data and Platform teams to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions.
* Drive frequent, high\-quality software releases, ensuring delivery is aligned with product priorities and business objectives.
* Champion a DevOps and "you build it, you run it" mindset, taking ownership across the full product lifecycle.
* Maintain high engineering standards, with a strong focus on automated testing, reliability, performance and measurable quality.
* Monitor and analyse engineering metrics to identify opportunities for improvement and ensure system health and performance.
* Evaluate and select appropriate technical solutions, balancing scalability, performance, complexity, cost and other key trade\-offs.
* Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance, helping the team make informed decisions on engineering approaches and technologies.
* Partner closely with Product to shape the technical vision, contribute ideas and build industry\-leading products and services.
* Continuously improve engineering practices and processes, encouraging innovation, collaboration and a culture of ownership


**Requirements**
**Skills \& Qualifications**
* Fluent English (C2 proficiency) \- Essential
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field
* Proven experience leading and mentoring software engineering teams, providing technical direction and supporting team development
* Strong experience building and optimising systems for performance, scalability and reliability
* Excellent hands\-on proficiency in Python
* Strong experience with cloud platforms, specifically AWS and Azure, as well as Infrastructure\-as\-Code tools such as Terraform
* Hands\-on experience with DevOps and infrastructure tooling, including CI/CD, Docker and Kubernetes (K8s)
* Experience with observability and monitoring tools, such as Prometheus, Grafana and Datadog
* Proven experience building, deploying and monitoring distributed systems, across both frontend and backend environments
* Hands\-on experience working with multiple data stores, including both SQL and NoSQL databases
* Demonstrable experience using AI to empower engineering teams and accelerate the software development lifecycle


**Desirable:**
* Experience building AI agents and workflows, including autonomous systems or multi\-agent architectures
* Experience with Generative AI tools and frameworks, such as LangGraph, CrewAI, Hugging Face and OpenAI APIs


**Benefits**
 Our people are at the heart of the business, and we have a culture of recognition and reward \- both through regular appraisals but also annual Extra Mile Awards where we celebrate those who have gone that extra mile in their role. We also encourage all our staff to incorporate their aspirations and interests into their career at Ten and we are there every step of the way in supporting development.
   

  

**All our employees also enjoy a range of benefits:**
* Offer flexible work arrangements including Hybrid work possibilities
* One (1\) month paid Sabbatical after 5 years of Service, without tapping into annual leave
* Access to lots of great travel and entertainment discounts as our clients' members would!

**Commitment to Diversity**
 We encourage diverse philosophies, cultures, and experiences. We appreciate diversity and are dedicated to creating an inclusive work environment for our employees. title: Engineering Lead
description:
**We’re looking for people to join the Access family, who share our passion for believing in better, and who will help us continue to grow.**









 Love Work. Love Life. Be You. \- is central to our success and how we give our customers the freedom to do more of what's important to them.
 








**What does Access offer you?**









 We offer a blended approach to office working, encouraging you to collaborate and connect in one of our thriving offices. We deliver on what we say, taking the development of our people seriously. We’ll work with you to progress your success plan and provide opportunities to accelerate your career.
 








**Position Summary** 




 The Lead Software Engineer is a ‘50:50’ role. Half the time you are in the code — shipping production software, holding the technical bar and setting the standard the team follows. The other half you are leading the people, the process and the architecture — running a high\-performing engineering stream and developing the engineers within it.
 







 You’ll be joining a small, value\-aligned structure: up to two streams of four engineers each, with Product cover per stream. QA is owned by engineering — there is no handoff to a separate team, and that is by design.
 







 The F\&B Software Company sits within Access Hospitality, with engineering teams distributed globally, and powers many millions of guest experiences every day. The portfolio includes ResDiary, Dish Cult, DesignMyNight, Collins, Tonic, Soda, Wireless Social, Paytronix, Paytronix Online Ordering, QikServe Digital Ordering, Kiosk, QikServe Connect, Access EPOS, Newbridge POS, GuestPOS, Acteol, Trail, Maintain, RotaReady and CPL.
 







 AI augmentation is a pre\-requisite for this role, not an optional extra. Access has invested in cutting\-edge AI tooling and we expect every engineer and leader to use AI pervasively to accelerate outcomes, raise quality, and shorten feedback loops. Lead Software Engineers are expected to model this behaviour, embed it into team standards and hold the bar for AI adoption across their streams. If you are not already working this way, you will need to get there fast.
 







**Key Accountabilities and Responsibilities** 




**Technical Leadership** 



* Spend approximately half your time as a hands\-on engineer: writing, reviewing and shipping production code to the same standard you hold your team to.
* Own the technical direction of your stream — architecture decisions, technology choices, design patterns and code standards.
* Set and maintain the engineering quality bar: code review standards, test coverage expectations, CI/CD discipline, observability and security practice.
* Identify and address technical debt proactively, balancing pragmatism with the long\-term health of the codebase.
* Contribute to platform\-wide architectural decisions, feeding your stream’s experience and evidence back into broader engineering strategy.







**People Leadership** 



* Own the performance, development and wellbeing of up to eight engineers across your streams.
* Run regular 1:1s, set clear goals, and give direct, actionable feedback — both positive and developmental.
* Manage the full performance cycle for your engineers: goal setting, mid\-year reviews, end\-of\-year assessments and, where necessary, performance improvement plans.
* Identify growth opportunities for each engineer and actively create the conditions for them to progress.
* Hire well — contribute to recruitment, assess candidates rigorously, and take accountability for the quality of who joins your team.
* Model the behaviours and working practices you expect from the team, including AI adoption, communication standards and engineering discipline.







**Delivery \& Process** 



* Keep your streams delivering consistently — predictable throughput, low change failure rate, fast recovery when things go wrong.
* Own the engineering process within your streams: sprint ceremonies, planning quality, backlog health and cross\-team dependency management.
* Work closely with Product to balance feature delivery against technical investment, making the trade\-offs visible and explicit rather than absorbed silently.
* Remove blockers for your engineers — escalate where needed, resolve where you can, and protect the team’s ability to focus.
* Ensure incidents are handled well: fast triage, clear communication, thorough post\-mortems, and unique failures — the same class of incident should not recur.







**Key Performance Indicators** 




**Technical** 



* Software owned by your streams meets reliability, latency and availability targets in production.
* Lead time for change trends downwards; deployment frequency trends upwards across your streams.
* Change failure rate stays under 15%; MTTR trends downwards.
* Critical and high security vulnerabilities patched within agreed SLAs (1 day / 14 days).
* AI tooling is a demonstrable, routine part of your workflow and embedded visibly in team standards.







**People** 



* Engineers in your streams have clear goals, regular feedback and a development plan they understand.
* Regrettable attrition is low; engineers in your streams are growing and progressing.
* Performance issues are identified early and managed directly, without escalation becoming the default.
* New hires reach productive contribution within an agreed onboarding window.







**Delivery** 



* Your streams deliver predictably against commitments made to Product and stakeholders.
* Failures are unique — the same defect or incident class does not recur.
* Technical debt is visible, prioritised and moving in the right direction.







**Skills, Knowledge, Experience \& Qualifications** 




**How We Work** 




 Before the tech stack, this is what working in the F\&B engineering team looks like. As a Lead Software Engineer you are expected to model these standards, not just meet them.
 


* AI tooling is your default starting point, not a fallback — Copilot, Claude Code, Devin, Cursor or equivalent are open before you write the first line.
* You use AI pervasively across the full development lifecycle: generating and reviewing code, writing tests, producing documentation, triaging incidents and researching unfamiliar domains.
* You can prompt effectively — you know how to get useful output, iterate on it, and critically evaluate what comes back rather than accepting it at face value.
* You treat AI\-generated code with the same scrutiny as code from a colleague — it gets reviewed, tested and owned by you.
* You actively embed AI working practices into your team — through standards, playbooks, code review culture and leading by example.
* You improve your AI working practices continuously and bring the team with you; this field moves fast and standing still is falling behind.
* Expect your interview process to include assessment on how you work with AI tooling — not just what you know without it. Come prepared to demonstrate your workflow, not just talk about it.







**Technical Foundation** 




 The fundamentals are non\-negotiable — your technical credibility is what earns the trust of your engineers.
 


* Strong commercial software engineering background with a track record of shipping production systems end\-to\-end.
* Clean code, automated testing and CI/CD discipline — you set the standard, which means you have to embody it.
* Comfortable across the stack — backend, frontend or full\-stack — able to review and contribute across the breadth of what your streams own.
* Solid SQL and relational database skills; experience with cloud\-hosted databases in production.
* Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs and/or event\-driven architectures.
* Familiarity with containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes or equivalent).
* Experience making and communicating architectural decisions, including the trade\-offs involved.







**Leadership \& People** 



* Proven experience leading a software engineering team — setting direction, managing performance and developing engineers.
* Direct, honest and constructive communicator — comfortable giving difficult feedback and having conversations that matter.
* Able to manage competing priorities across engineering and people responsibilities without dropping either.
* Experience running engineering process — agile delivery, planning, retrospectives, incident management.
* Comfortable working asynchronously across distributed teams (UK and India).







**Technologies** 




 Access F\&B runs a broad and evolving tech stack. We care far more about solid fundamentals and the ability to learn than exact technology match.
 


* Java — present across several F\&B product areas.
* TypeScript / React — frontend and web\-based ordering and management interfaces.
* Azure — our primary cloud platform; experience with Azure\-native services (App Service, Service Bus, SQL, AKS, Key Vault) is valuable.
* AWS — also present across parts of the F\&B portfolio.







**Security \& Compliance** 



* Working knowledge of security fundamentals: auth and authorisation patterns, secrets management, encryption at rest and in transit, and PII handling.
* Awareness of GDPR and UK GDPR as they apply to software systems handling guest and payment data.











**What are we all about?** 








 The Access Group is one of the largest UK\-headquartered business management software providers. It provides solutions that empower more than 160,000 small and mid\-sized organisations in commercial and non\-profit sectors across Europe, USA and APAC, giving every employee the freedom to do more of what's important. Its innovative cloud solutions and integrated AI software experience across multiple Access products transform how business technology is used.
 







 With
 **over 9,300 talented individuals driving innovation and customer excellence** 
 , we’re shaping the future of work. And we want you to be part of it. At Access,
 **people are at the heart of everything we do** 
 . We’re committed to creating an inclusive, high\-performing culture where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive. If you’re excited about this role \- even if your experience doesn’t tick every box \- you might be exactly who we’re looking for.
 







 We believe in equality for all and the transformative power of diversity. So why not join our vibrant team, where you can love what you do, love how you live, and most importantly, be authentically you?
 







 Let’s make a difference together.
 



**Love Work. Love Life. Be You.**

title: Director-Software Engineering-Unify Energy
description:
We are seeking an experienced and strategic Director of Software Engineering to lead engineering for the Unify Energy platform. This role will provide technical, organizational, and delivery leadership for software and data capabilities serving the oil and gas industry. The Director will align engineering execution with customer and business priorities while advancing a secure, scalable platform that helps energy organizations manage high\-value information, streamline operational workflows, and improve access to trusted data across the asset lifecycle.
   

  

 The Director will partner closely with Product Management, business leadership, Architecture, Information Security, DevOps, Data Engineering, Quality Engineering, Implementation, Customer Success, and other software teams. This leader will translate industry needs into an executable engineering strategy, coordinate cross\-team dependencies, and ensure that product investments produce measurable customer, operational, and financial outcomes.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a hands\-on strategic leader with deep experience delivering complex SaaS and cloud\-native platforms, leading distributed engineering teams, and building data\-intensive solutions for regulated or asset\-intensive industries. Oil and gas domain experience is strongly preferred, including familiarity with upstream, midstream, or downstream workflows; land, lease, well, facility, and asset records; regulatory information; document and data onboarding; and integration with industry and enterprise systems.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Lead, mentor, and develop high\-performing engineering teams responsible for the Unify Energy platform and related software, data, integration, and automation capabilities.
* Own the engineering strategy, technical roadmap, execution plan, and delivery outcomes for Unify Energy in alignment with product strategy, customer commitments, revenue goals, and long\-term platform direction.
* Build strong working partnerships with oil and gas business leaders, customers, Product Management, Implementation, and Customer Success to understand industry workflows, prioritize the highest\-value problems, and convert business outcomes into clear engineering plans.
* Provide technical leadership across SaaS software engineering, cloud\-native architecture, APIs and integrations, data pipelines, search and document services, analytics, workflow automation, and applied AI.
* Oversee the full software development lifecycle, from discovery and architecture through development, testing, deployment, monitoring, support, and continuous improvement.
* Drive delivery of scalable, secure, and maintainable capabilities that support energy information ingestion, normalization, indexing, classification, validation, search, retrieval, workflow, and reporting.
* Advance platform capabilities that enable Access to serve as a trusted steward of customers’ physical and digital information assets by supporting metadata management, intuitive search, filtering, navigation, and map\-based discovery within the SaaS platform. Lead the data engineering capabilities required to ingest, organize, and enrich customer data so it becomes more accessible, useful, and valuable across oil and gas workflows.
* Guide integration strategy for industry and enterprise systems, including data exchanges, APIs, batch interfaces, identity services, content repositories, GIS or spatial data, analytics platforms, and customer\-specific systems of record.
* Lead data engineering and data quality practices for high\-volume structured and unstructured information, including ETL/ELT, metadata management, lineage, reconciliation, observability, and reliable downstream consumption.
* Guide responsible use of AI and machine learning to improve document understanding, metadata extraction, classification, entity matching, search relevance, workflow recommendations, quality assurance, and operational efficiency.
* Ensure solutions are designed with appropriate attention to cybersecurity, privacy, records retention, legal hold, auditability, data residency, regulatory obligations, customer controls, and business continuity.
* Establish outcome\-based planning and measurement. Define engineering and business KPIs for major initiatives, including delivery predictability, quality, reliability, adoption, customer value, operational efficiency, and revenue or retention impact.
* Partner with Architecture, Information Security, DevOps, Quality Engineering, Data Engineering, and Operations to establish technical standards, reusable patterns, release controls, service\-level objectives, and operational readiness.
* Monitor portfolio health, delivery metrics, product quality, reliability, risks, dependencies, capacity, and technical debt; make clear tradeoffs and proactively resolve or escalate issues that threaten business outcomes.
* Continuously improve platform architecture, technical health, and integration patterns while protecting customer continuity and sequencing change based on value, risk, and delivery readiness.
* Support talent planning through hiring, coaching, performance management, succession planning, role clarity, and the creation of an accountable, inclusive, and customer\-focused engineering culture.
* Represent Unify Energy engineering in executive, product, customer, and governance forums, providing clear updates on strategy, delivery performance, investment needs, risks, opportunities, and decisions required.
* Stay current with emerging trends in energy technology, information management, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, data platforms, AI\-enabled automation, SaaS architecture, and software delivery practices.


**First 6\-12 Months**
 The initial focus will be to establish a clear engineering and product delivery baseline for Unify Energy, strengthen alignment between customer needs and the technical roadmap, and improve execution predictability. The Director will assess the platform architecture, team capabilities, operating model, delivery commitments, reliability, security posture, technical debt, and customer integration landscape. They will work closely with Product, Operations, and customer\-facing teams to confirm the highest\-priority business and product outcomes and translate them into a focused, sequenced delivery plan.
   

  

 Success will be demonstrated through clearer accountability, stronger engineering and product operating rhythms, improved delivery and quality metrics, reduced execution risk, deeper customer partnership, and measurable progress on the highest\-value Unify Energy capabilities.

Kubernetes Orchestration: Manage cluster health, troubleshoot pod eviction or crash loops, view container resource limits, and run diagnostic deployments utilizing advanced kubectl commands. Observability, Reliability \& Automated Recovery Telemetry Dashboards: Navigate and customize production monitoring workflows within Datadog, Dynatrace, Prometheus, and Grafana to narrow down systemic bottlenecks. Runbook Automation: Draft, refine, and execute technical runbooks and automated scripts to speed up manual triage and ensure consistent resolution steps. Observability Toolsets: High competence investigating production incidents using tools like Datadog, Dynatrace, Prometheus, and Grafana. Web Server Architecture: Intermediate understanding of Nginx configuration structures, upstream load balancing, and performance tuning. Cloud \& OS Infrastructure: Familiarity navigating Google Cloud Platform (GCP) systems along with strong Linux/Unix command\-line tools for running performance diagnostics. Operational Flexibility: Preparedness to participate in rotating shift schedules (including weekend support coverage) to secure zero\-downtime banking services.

title: Staff Engineer - Data Path
description:
DDN is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join the Data Ocean engineering team and develop high\-performance data path software for next\-generation AI and enterprise storage platforms.
   

  

 This role focuses on designing, implementing, and optimizing core data path services that enable intelligent caching, object storage integration, metadata management, and efficient data movement across modern storage environments.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a strong systems engineer with deep C/C\+\+ development expertise, experience building high\-performance Linux\-based software, and a passion for solving complex storage and distributed systems challenges.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on engineering role requiring ownership of design, implementation, debugging, performance optimization, and delivery of production\-quality software.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Data Path Software Development
   

  

* Design and implement high\-performance data path components for the Data Ocean platform.
* Develop intelligent caching capabilities for object storage workloads.
* Build scalable services for data movement across object, file, and block storage environments.
* Implement metadata management services supporting efficient object tracking, lookup, and on\-demand retrieval.
* Develop cache management capabilities including quota management, eviction policies, and lifecycle controls.
* Optimize data transfer pipelines for throughput, latency, scalability, and reliability.
* Analyze, debug, and optimize system performance across large\-scale storage workloads.
* Develop production\-quality C/C\+\+ software for high\-performance storage systems.
* Design and implement multithreaded, concurrent systems software on Linux platforms.
* Work on storage data path components involving caching, metadata handling, I/O processing, and distributed coordination.
* Improve scalability, reliability, and performance of core storage services through profiling and optimization.
* Troubleshoot complex system issues involving performance, concurrency, and data consistency.
* Participate in architecture discussions, technical design reviews, and code reviews.
* Collaborate with senior engineers, architects, and cross\-functional teams across global engineering locations.
* Work closely with QA, performance engineering, and release teams to deliver reliable production software.
* Contribute to engineering best practices, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 8\+ years of experience developing systems software, storage software, or distributed systems.
* Strong expertise in C/C\+\+ programming with experience developing production\-grade software.
* Strong Linux systems programming experience.
* Experience with multithreaded programming, concurrency, synchronization, and performance tuning.
* Understanding of storage systems, filesystems, or distributed storage architectures.
* Experience working with object storage concepts and APIs, including S3\.

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience developing distributed storage systems or high\-performance data platforms.
* Knowledge of filesystem internals, metadata management, and namespace services.
* Experience with intelligent caching, data tiering, replication, or data mobility solutions.

* Experience integrating cloud storage with enterprise storage platforms.

 As a Senior Software Engineer – Data Path, Data Ocean, you will work on foundational storage technologies powering next\-generation AI, HPC, and enterprise workloads.
   

  

 You will have the opportunity to design and build high\-performance distributed systems software, solve challenging scalability and performance problems, and contribute to a global engineering team delivering advanced data management solutions for modern AI infrastructure.

 This is a senior, high\-impact role designed for a pragmatic, battle\-tested Technical Architect with strong hands\-on development experience. You will work amongst the sharpest minds in the financial fraternity to build a next\-generation platform vision.
   

  

 This role requires a hands\-on Technical Architect who stays "in the trenches." The individual will combine the absolute best traits of a technical visionary and an execution\-focused leader, bringing the capability to structure robust backend engines while aggressively deep\-diving into complex production environments to debug and resolve issues at the highest speed.
   

  

**Requirements**
 Key Responsibilities

 Personally lead the hands\-on prototyping, design, and integration of AI/ML utilities into core production pipelines (e.g., smart reconciliation engines, fraud pattern recognition, and transaction optimization).

 Deep hands\-on mastery of Java and the Spring Boot ecosystem.

 spring, AI

title: Senior Backend Engineer, NIRA
description:
Join the Tilt team
   

  

 At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile\-first products and machine learning\-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real\-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide
 **,** 
 we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.
   

  

 NIRA is building a consumer credit platform for Middle India, targeting \~200m underservied people. Active in 5000\+ cities and processing 15,000\+ loan applications/day, NIRA is backed by and integrated with US\-based Tilt.
   

  

**The opportunity \- Senior Backend Engineer, NIRA**
 We’re looking for a strong Senior Software Engineer to join NIRA’s engineering team. You will have the opportunity to shape strategy for the infrastructure and product roadmap. This role will give you the ability to have a direct and outsized impact on technical projects, leading to enormous potential for career\-growth.
   

  

**This role is Hybrid, based in our Bangalore office 2\-3 days/week.**
**How You'll Make An Impact**
* Work closely with the local NIRA Engineering team, and partner with the broader APAC Engineering team to increase the scale our platform can handle.
* Expand the platform to support multiple financial products and underlying instruments.
* Drive iterations on credit policy and improve credit decision systems.
* Collaborate with product, credit/finance, compliance, support and analytics teams.


**Why you're a great fit**
* Strong experience using Java (ideally .net too).
* Demonstrated experience working in AWS\-native environments, using tools like DynamoDB, Athena and Lambda.
* You have experience with scaled technical solutions \- have worked on projects to increase the scaleability of a platform.
* Clear communicator, ability to clearly articulate technical solutions and collaborate with colleagues globally.
* Product Engineer mentality \- own your solutions from start to finish.


**Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.**
**What You'll Get At Tilt**
* Virtual\-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.
* Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.
* Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.
* Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.
* Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)
* Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.


**The Tilt Way**
 We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non\-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the \[virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.
   

  

**You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.**
